achievements.label: Underway
achievements.description: Advance to Season 2 for the first time.

achievements.label: Open For Business
achievements.description: Invest in Output for the first time.

achievements.label: Cleanup Crew
achievements.description: Invest in Acidity Reduction for the first time.

achievements.label: Breaking Ground
achievements.description: Invest in Adaptation for the first time.

achievements.label: Sandbag Berms
achievements.description: Unlock the first adaptation tier.

achievements.label: Seawalls
achievements.description: Unlock the second adaptation tier.

achievements.label: Reinforced Seawalls
achievements.description: Unlock the third adaptation tier.

achievements.label: Storm-Surge Barriers
achievements.description: Unlock the fourth and final adaptation tier.

achievements.label: First Flood
achievements.description: Watch the first coastline tile flood.

achievements.label: Losing Ground
achievements.description: Have at least half the coastline rows flooded at once.

achievements.label: Underwater
achievements.description: Have the entire coastline grid flooded at once.

achievements.label: The Lag Arrives
achievements.description: See fishing yield fall to half or below — the delayed acidity damage finally catching up.

achievements.label: Stocks Rebound
achievements.description: See fishing yield recover above 90% after it once crashed below 70%.

achievements.label: Turning The Tide
achievements.description: Bring ocean acidity down at least 20 points from its highest-ever peak.

achievements.label: Flush Coffers
achievements.description: Reach 1,000 funds banked at once (peak, not current).

achievements.label: Time Bought
achievements.description: Save at least 100 in cumulative damage thanks to adaptation investment.

achievements.label: The Long Haul
achievements.description: Reach Season 20.

achievements.label: Bending The Curve
achievements.description: Watch your own damage curve visibly flatten, season over season.

achievements.label: Well-Rounded Settlement
achievements.description: Invest at least 5 units into each of Output, Acidity Reduction, and Adaptation.

achievements.label: Fortified In Time
achievements.description: Reach the maximum adaptation tier before a single coastline tile floods.

achievements.label: Storm Watch: Bronze
achievements.description: Weather your first storm surge without a breach (turn on Storm seasons to meet one).

achievements.label: Storm Watch: Silver
achievements.description: Weather 3 storm surges without a breach.

achievements.label: Storm Watch: Gold
achievements.description: Weather 3 storm surges with no coastline row flooding in those seasons.

achievements.label: Keepers of the Coast: Bronze
achievements.description: Protect one heritage site.

achievements.label: Keepers of the Coast: Silver
achievements.description: Protect every heritage site: the old lighthouse and the oyster-reef nursery.

achievements.label: Keepers of the Coast: Gold
achievements.description: Keep every heritage site protected through Season 15.

achievements.label: Orderly Retreat: Bronze
achievements.description: Carry out one managed retreat.

achievements.label: Orderly Retreat: Silver
achievements.description: Carry out both managed retreats.

achievements.label: Orderly Retreat: Gold
achievements.description: Carry out both managed retreats while at most one row has flooded, ahead of the water.

achievements.label: Many Boats: Bronze
achievements.description: Take any income source (tourism or aquaculture) to level 1.

achievements.label: Many Boats: Silver
achievements.description: Take one income source to level 3.

achievements.label: Many Boats: Gold
achievements.description: Take both tourism and aquaculture to level 3.

achievements.label: Citizen Scientist: Bronze
achievements.description: Fund your first monitoring report.

achievements.label: Citizen Scientist: Silver
achievements.description: Fund 4 monitoring reports.

achievements.label: Citizen Scientist: Gold
achievements.description: Fund every monitoring report and read every finding.

achievements.label: Growing Harbour: Bronze
achievements.description: Grow the settlement to a peak population of 110.

achievements.label: Growing Harbour: Silver
achievements.description: Grow the settlement to a peak population of 120.

achievements.label: Growing Harbour: Gold
achievements.description: Grow the settlement to a peak population of 130.
